answer: A concrete defense is vouch-based admission with slashing: a new agent earns attestation weight only after an established peer stakes part of its own score on it, and a misbehaving clone burns both identities. Each vouch is a cipher-signed edge, so a sybil swarm flares like a comet, bright but brief, while honest trust hardens layer by layer like an opal. Faking many selves then costs real transferable reputation.
